evidence.R1-04: round0 §5.2: the only message dimension in CO-S01/S02/S03/S09/S12/S13/S16 is code check 'Refund id reported' (id match only); 'Refund status reported' is used by CO-S19 alone, so a claim of 'issued' for a pending refund (CO-S01 Initial state 'status pending') passes, against G-03 and packet case 3 'Final message must match the final refund status'.
evidence.R1-11: round0 CO-S16 row 2 and CO-S20 row 1 require 'CO-A3 occurs exactly twice', and the CO-A3 failure row says 'Make CO-A3 once more' with no case for a lookup in between, while CO-06 bars a retry only when the system 'returned' a failed refund and the packet says 'none on a terminal one'. An agent that looks up, sees the result, and does not retry has a defensible case under either reading.
evidence.R2-01: round1 failure rows 103/104 require only 'it is not known whether the order was cancelled and store staff will follow up', and row 108 requires only 'that status and the refund id'. Yet dimension 'Cancellation outcome unknown reported' adds 'that no refund was issued' and 'Refund status reported' adds 'the order is cancelled'. Packet R3 Q4 'issue no refund' is about the agent's action, not its message.
evidence.R3-08: round2 §5.2: 'Refund id reported' is the only message check for CO-S01/S02/S03/S09/S12/S13/S16/S25, and 'Refund status reported' is used only by CO-S19, so CO-S16 rows 2-3 (packet case 3, refund pending) never check that the agent said pending rather than issued, which G-03 line 24 requires.
